evidence.finding: Experimental: run agents on user-reachable Linux servers over SSH; each remote agent keeps a local tmux window and appears in dashboard/sidebar/status/list as handle@remote; agent keeps working while local machine sleeps, loses network, or closes the window; window reconnects by itself; workmux merge brings work home; local machine stays Git source of truth.

evidence.title: Setting up a server
evidence.locator: Requirements; Server or Docker; Install and check; Supplemental files; Security
evidence.finding: Requires Linux x86-64/ARM64, promptless SSH, git, tmux 3.3+, systemd linger, API access; host mode (no sandbox) vs Docker mode per sandbox.enabled/isolation; server never talks to Git hosting and gets no origin; remote_files allowlist (64 MiB cap); no host-command proxying on servers.

evidence.title: Logins and secrets
evidence.locator: Per-agent login table; Copy logins; Claude long-lived token; Environment variables
evidence.finding: remote login runs each agent native login flow (claude/codex/gemini/opencode/pi/omp) with localhost port forwarding; --import does a one-time credential copy (with rotation caveats); setup-token for Claude; sandbox env passthrough read once per workspace and stored privately on server.

evidence.title: Skills

evidence.finding: Six product-shipped skills; workmux setup --skills installs to Claude/OpenCode/Pi/OMP dirs (manual copy documented); dashboard m keybinding triggers /merge; /merge commits/rebases/merges with conflict review; /worktree delegates with --fork option; /coordinator manages full lifecycle.

evidence.title: Workflows
